## Validation

Use expanding-window temporal folds. Report mean and fold-level log loss/Brier score with uncertainty intervals. Compare calibration curves and prediction sharpness. No random train/test split should be used unless temporal order is demonstrably absent.

## Sensitivity and Robustness

Vary lag length, state persistence \(\phi\), regularization \(\lambda\), training-window length, treatment of sparse classes, and aggregation choices. Refit after excluding suspected duplicate or anomalous rows. Assess whether rankings and conclusions persist under these perturbations.

## Falsification Tests

- Shuffle temporal order: predictive performance should materially deteriorate.
- Replace lagged predictors with future values as a negative-control audit; any apparent advantage indicates leakage.
- Compare against a constant-distribution model.
- Inspect residual autocorrelation and calibration drift over time.

## Reviewer Risks

Primary risks are malformed headers, unclear target semantics, temporal leakage, overfitting with only 481 rows, class imbalance, denominator misinterpretation, metric mismatch, and unsupported claims about Wordle strategy. Any result depending on unavailable fields or unverified contest rules remains **pending**.
